spaces.//: 230 KiB. The About dialog was rebuilt on slides' (sections with real headings, the update card with signed release notes, an auto-check switch, document properties, a content readout, and the two irreversible actions given their own weight). Measured on this stack, same machine, same node: 213,434 B before and 229,634 B after — +16,200 B. Nearly all of it is language, not layout: packed.ts alone grew 22,644 B raw for 49 new keys × 8 locales (29 of them lifted from slides' catalogs, which is why they cost bytes and no translation), while the dialog's own code and CSS came to roughly 4 KB raw. Headroom stays deliberate for the reason the previous note gives: the shell is one compressed block and the packer's output differs across node versions, so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason. CI is the number that counts.
